heading: Real Words From Our Travellers
subheading: Rated 5.0 by 4,500+ travellers on Google Reviews.

items.quote: Sikkim trip, local sightseeing, Nathula pass, Lachen and Lachung arranged very affordably. Really we enjoyed the Sikkim Holiday Package, though we are senior citizens. Whenever any doubts I called and the team cleared them immediately. Book without any hesitation!
items.author: Sudhir Hastak

items.quote: I recently had a 4 day 3 night tour to Sikkim. This Sikkim Holiday Package was budget friendly and smooth. Special thanks to the support team for guidance at every step, customizing the tour as per our requirements.
items.author: Biki Gouda

items.quote: Our Sikkim trip was booked directly with the local travel desk. Cabs and permits were completely hassle free. The team was very helpful in planning out our whole itinerary. A smooth and memorable journey through the mountains.
items.author: Amit Kumar

items.quote: I booked the Sikkim Trip Package for 8 days across the state including hotel booking, taxi, permits etc. Everything was flawless and support from the coordinators was amazing. Looking forward to our next tour with them.
items.author: Anuj Somani
